choose.when:
/* RealMapper.selectTotal 전체 현황 - 현재 시간 기준 */
SELECT ISNULL(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(CONVERT(CHAR(8), GETDATE(), 8), 4, 8), ':', ''), '00:00') AS IN_TIME , ISNULL(SUM(SEND_CNT), 0) AS SEND_CNT FROM T_MSG_TRAFFIC WHERE IN_TIME <= GETDATE() AND IN_TIME >= DATEADD(N, -#{totalMonTime}, GETDATE())

mapper.select: /* RealMapper.selectRealHistTableList 테이블별 현황 */ SELECT TOP 1 ISNULL(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(CONVERT(CHAR(8), IN_TIME ,8), 4, 8), ':', ''), '00:00') IN_TIME , ISNULL(SUM(SEND_CNT), 0) SEND_CNT , ISNULL(SUM(SUCC_CNT), 0) SUCC_CNT , ISNULL(SUM(FAIL_CNT), 0) FAIL_CNT FROM T_MSG_TRAFFIC WHERE IN_TIME IN ( SELECT TOP 1 IN_TIME FROM T_MSG_TRAFFIC WHERE TABLE_CODE = #{tableCode} GROUP BY IN_TIME ORDER BY IN_TIME DESC ) AND TABLE_CODE = #{tableCode} GROUP BY IN_TIME ORDER BY IN_TIME DESC
